name: @dealora/integration
description: DEALORA Phase 23 CRM Integrations (ROADMAP.md §30): a standardized adapter interface with explicit permission scopes and a registry that never hard-codes a vendor. Prepares a CRM change-set from stored rows, binds a human Level 2 decision to its digest, and executes only through an adapter confirmation. No credential is stored, no adapter performs network I/O in this repository, and no opportunity value is ever written.
